verified.title: Apple Watch band offerings expand for spring 2017
verified.role: press contact (first listed, with Lance Lin)
verified.summary: Apple introduced its spring 2017 Apple Watch band lineup, including a wide-stripe Woven Nylon band, standalone Nike Sport Bands and new Apple Watch Hermès bands in new colors.
verified.text:
[EXCERPT] UPDATE — March 21, 2017
Apple Watch band offerings expand for spring 2017
Featuring New Striped Woven Nylon, Nike Sport and Apple Watch Hermès Bands

Today, Apple introduced a new lineup of fresh and bright band colors that give customers more opportunity than ever to personalize and customize their Apple Watch. Highlights for the season include a wide stripe Woven Nylon band, standalone Nike Sport Bands and beautifully crafted Apple Watch Hermès bands in striking new colors. All-new bands are available to order today from apple.com and for purchase at select Apple Stores, Apple Authorized Resellers and carriers in late March.

The new collection of bands include:
Sport in Pebble, Azure and Camellia
Woven Nylon in Berry, Tahoe Blue, Orange, Red, Pollen and Midnight Blue
Classic Buckle with new buckle design in Sapphire, Berry and Taupe

The Nike Sport Bands will now be sold separately in: Anthracite/Black; Pure Platinum/White; Black/Volt
[...]
Pricing and Availability
Apple Watch is available in two different case sizes, 38mm and 42mm. [...] The Sport and Woven Nylon bands are $49 (US) and the Classic Buckle is $149 (US). [...]
